_description: Split config for MEDITECH EHI export analysis. Two-way split based on export mechanism completeness. Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM eChart-based) covers ALL platforms for acute, but only Expanse+6.15 have full acute+ambulatory coverage via Config 1. Older platforms (6.08/CS/MAGIC) need Config 2 (MRI/DR CSV-based) to cover ambulatory (and CS/MAGIC use it for acute+ambulatory as an alternative). The split groups platforms by whether Config 1 alone is sufficient.

splits.focus: MEDITECH platforms where Config 1 provides complete coverage: Expanse (2.2, 2.1) and 6.15/6.1. Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based) exports Electronic Chart documents + US Core FHIR R4 + C-CDA + supplemental reports for BOTH acute and ambulatory settings. These platforms do not need Config 2. Evaluate Config 1 documentation for completeness and compliance.
products: MEDITECH 6.1 Electronic Health Record Core HCIS

splits.focus: MEDITECH platforms requiring Config 2 for ambulatory coverage: 6.08/6.0, Client/Server, and MAGIC. Config 1 (eChart-based) covers acute-only for these platforms. Config 2 (MRI/DR-based) provides CSV data export + FHIR R4 + C-CDA for ambulatory settings; CS and MAGIC can also use Config 2 for acute+ambulatory as a single path. Each platform has its own CSV data dictionary PDF: CS uses csacuteandambehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, MAGIC uses mgehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, 6.08 ambulatory uses 608ehiexportcsv.pdf. Evaluate BOTH Config 1 (acute) AND Config 2 (ambulatory/combined) documentation plus platform-specific CSV data dictionaries.
products: MEDITECH 6.0 Electronic Health Record Core HCIS
